result.prompt: Use generate_image to create a flat, print-ready garage sale poster in a fixed 4:5 portrait aspect ratio, suitable for printing and sharing in a neighbourhood Facebook group. With no source image, establish an original design; there is no existing identity, pose, clothing, background or lighting to preserve. Show the artwork straight-on, perfectly rectangular, with no perspective, frame, wall mockup or photographic setting. Use a warm ivory background, deep navy lettering, sunny yellow accents and small coral-red details. Place the exact text “Garage Sale · Saturday 9am · 14 Elm St” prominently across the upper and middle area, wrapping only after each middle-dot separator so the wording, punctuation and order remain unchanged. Set it in bold, highly legible sans-serif type, with “Garage Sale” largest and the remaining information comfortably readable at phone-screen size. Keep generous margins and clear spacing. Along the bottom third, arrange simple vector illustrations of a pale teal table lamp with a yellow shade, three stacked books, a coral ceramic mug, a small wooden chair and a leafy plant in a terracotta pot. Use crisp silhouettes, restrained outlines and solid matte colours, with no gradients, realistic lighting or textures. Add no other lettering, logos or watermarks. Review the completed still for exact spelling, readability and spacing before using it as any video reference.
